header: What three branches on one stock figure produced
lead: Measured against the same twelve months of the previous year, on the same three sites, with the same staff.
note: Period: April 2024 to March 2025, compared with April 2023 to March 2024. The garden season falls inside both windows. The fourth site, opened in June 2024, is excluded from every figure here.

metrics.title: Counter promises kept
metrics.text: Orders promised for a date and delivered on it, up from 71 per cent.

metrics.title: Stocktake, down from 9
metrics.text: Counted branch by branch during opening hours instead of over two closed weekends.

metrics.title: Stock value released
metrics.text: Chiefly duplicate lines the three sites had each been ordering separately.

metrics.title: Closed trading days
metrics.text: The changeover was run in the eleven weeks before the season, with no site shut.
